# This Is The Heading

Alpha is `r params$alpha` and the ratio is `r params$ratio`.

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Iris Petal Dimensions",
       x = "Petal Length",
       y = "Petal Width") +
  theme_minimal()
```
